state_budget_rule.interpretation: The exact causal counter is fixed; only the certified evidence refinement grows. The cap is the official ten-reference target count. Total external-state bytes divided by model parameters must strictly decrease.

design_rationale: FWE confirmation retained positive mean growth but failed strict scale confirmation because its three-reference target saturates. Official CWE supplies ten references, allowing a preregistered width-linear 3/5/10 evidence refinement without changing the causal counter or safe fusion principle.
causal_memory_invariant: Only numbered list items between the official CWE context marker and held-out final question are counted. Multiword items remain atomic. The outputs field is used solely for a post-read set audit and scoring. Exceeding 512 unique items is a hard failure.
certified_fusion_invariant: ASCENT appends only target-blind top-frequency items decoded from the bounded causal counter to the exact frozen Foundation output. The Foundation text is retained byte-for-byte, so certified evidence cannot remove an already correct reference.
measurement_boundary: Foundation is one exact greedy full-context decode. Fixed and scale ASCENT scores append certified counter evidence without a second neural decode. Counter time/state and model decode time/memory are reported separately.
development_gate: Every scale ASCENT gain and both adjacent gain differences must be positive; no scale ASCENT regression is allowed; scale expansion must beat fixed three-word evidence at 360M and 1.7B; exact parser, provenance, clean-tree, native-length, and strictly decreasing relative-state-cost gates must pass. A pass authorizes only three entirely new official-data confirmation seeds.
interpretation: Development-only test of RULER's official ten-answer aggregation task. FPVM is excluded by user direction.
